definition_zh: 投球手；保龄球玩家；圆顶硬礼帽
definition_en: a person who bowls or delivers the ball in cricket; also a hard round-brimmed hat
core_image: 三幅画面：板球场上助跑投球的球员；球道上掷出保龄球的玩家；绅士头顶那顶圆硬礼帽
scene: 比赛最后一局，全场屏息。The bowler ran up and delivered the ball at terrifying speed.
sceneCN: 这里 bowler 是「投球手」（第 1 个义项：板球中投球的人）；句意是投球手助跑后以惊人的速度将球投出。

derivatives.zh: 词源基础动词，义为「投球；打保龄球」
由动词加名词后缀构成，义为「保龄球运动」
由复合词加形容词后缀构成，义为「戴圆顶礼帽的」

senses.title: The player who delivers the ball in cricket
senses.definition: the fielding player who bowls the ball to the batter in cricket
senses.definitionCN: 板球防守方负责向击球手投球球员
senses.example: The young bowler took five wickets in his first match.
senses.exampleCN: 这位年轻投球手首场比赛就拿下了五个三柱门。
senses.why: The verb bowl names the act of delivering the ball, and the agent suffix -er attaches to the doer.
senses.whyCN: 动词 bowl 指投球动作，加上表人后缀 -er 即指投球之人。

senses.title: A participant in bowling games
senses.definition: a person who plays tenpin bowling or similar games
senses.definitionCN: 玩十瓶保龄球或类似游戏的人
senses.example: She is the best bowler in our league.
senses.exampleCN: 她是我们联赛里最厉害的保龄球玩家。
senses.why: The same verb bowl covers rolling the ball down the alley, so its player shares the name.
senses.whyCN: 同一个动词 bowl 也指沿球道滚球，其玩家自然共用这个称呼。

senses.title: A hard round-brimmed hat
senses.definition: a man's hat with a hard, rounded crown and a narrow brim
senses.definitionCN: 硬质圆顶、窄帽檐的男式礼帽
senses.example: The banker wore a black bowler to work.
senses.exampleCN: 那位银行家戴着黑色圆顶硬礼帽上班。
senses.why: The hat was named in the nineteenth century for the Earl of Leicester's gamekeepers, after the bowling motion the hard dome resembled in shape.
senses.whyCN: 这顶帽子得名于十九世纪莱斯特伯爵猎场看守人所订制，其硬质圆顶与碗状木球的形似让它随 bowl 一词得名。

senses.title: A shallow dish, as in bowl of a pipe
senses.definition: the rounded hollow part of something, such as a pipe
senses.definitionCN: 器物上圆凹的部分，如烟斗的斗钵
senses.example: He tamped the tobacco into the bowler of his pipe.
senses.exampleCN: 他把烟丝按进烟斗的斗钵里。
senses.why: The image of the rounded wooden ball extends to any rounded hollow, and the -er form survives in dialect use.
senses.whyCN: 圆木球的意象扩展到一切圆凹之物，这一 -er 形式留存于方言用法。

senses.title: A person skilled in delivering anything
senses.definition: figuratively, one who delivers remarks or challenges the way a bowler delivers a ball
senses.definitionCN: 比喻像投球手那样「掷出」言论或挑战的人
senses.example: As a debater he is a fast bowler of hard questions.
senses.exampleCN: 作为辩手，他像一个快投手，接连抛出刁钻问题。
senses.why: The sporting act of hurling at a target maps onto verbal exchange.
senses.whyCN: 朝目标掷球的体育动作被映射到言语交锋上。

senses.title: A symbol of respectability
senses.definition: the hat as an emblem of the respectable city gentleman
senses.definitionCN: 作为城市绅士体面象征的那顶帽子
senses.example: In old films, the bowler marks the city clerk at once.
senses.exampleCN: 在老电影里，圆顶礼帽一出场就点明了都市小职员身份。
senses.why: Because one class wore one hat, the object absorbed the class's meaning.
senses.whyCN: 一个阶层固定戴一种帽子，物品便吸入了阶层的含义。

senses.title: The position or role of bowling in a team
senses.definition: the bowling side or duty within a cricket team
senses.definitionCN: 板球队中负责投球的一方或职责
senses.example: The captain chose him for the bowler role in the final over.
senses.exampleCN: 队长选他在最后一局承担投球任务。
senses.why: A doer's name can stand for the slot that doer occupies.
senses.whyCN: 行为者的名称可转指其占据的位置。

senses.title: A gamekeeper's hat by origin
senses.definition: the hat in its historical sense, designed for gamekeepers on horseback
senses.definitionCN: 该帽的历史本义：为骑马的猎场看守人设计的帽子
senses.example: The bowler was first ordered as headgear for mounted gamekeepers.
senses.exampleCN: 圆顶硬礼帽最初是为骑马的猎场看守人订制的头具。
senses.why: Tracing the word backward keeps alive the profession story inside the object name.
senses.whyCN: 回溯词源，物件名称里那段职业故事得以留存。

intro.en: Bowler is the agent noun of bowl; the hat sense grew in the nineteenth century from the same family.
intro.cn: bowler 是 bowl 的施动者名词；帽子义于十九世纪由同一词族发展而来。

items.en: The verb bowl meant to roll a ball, recorded from the fourteenth century, probably from Old French boule.
items.cn: 动词 bowl 意为滚球，十四世纪已有记录，一般认为源自古法语 boule。

items.en: Old French boule meant a ball, from Latin bulla, a bubble or rounded object.
items.cn: 古法语 boule 意为球，来自拉丁语 bulla（气泡、圆物）。

items.en: Latin bulla meant a bubble or knob; its earlier origin is uncertain.
items.cn: 拉丁语 bulla 意为气泡或圆突；更早来源不确定。

items.en: The agent noun bowler formed from bowl plus -er for the player.
items.cn: 十五世纪由 bowl 加 -er 构成表人名词 bowler。

items.en: In 1849 the hard hat was made for Thomas William Coke's gamekeepers, and bowler hat entered English.
items.cn: 1849 年，为托马斯·威廉·科克的猎场看守人订制了这种硬帽，bowler hat 由此进入英语。

items.en: Modern English keeps the player senses first and the hat sense as a chiefly British usage.
items.cn: 现代英语以「玩家」诸义为主，「帽子」义主要为英式用法。

note.en: Bowler wears two masks at once: the athlete and the hat; spelling twins are few.
note.cn: bowler 一词身兼两相：运动员与帽子；拼写近似词不多。

entries.definition: to roll a ball, or a rounded dish
the game of rolling balls at pins
wearing a bowler hat, often of officials
entries.definitionCN: 戴圆顶礼帽的；常指官员形象
锅炉；与 bowler 仅一字母之差，词源不同
凉亭；树荫处；拼写相近但词源无关

entries.definition: the player who throws the ball in baseball
entries.definitionCN: 棒球投手；与板球投球手角色对应

entries.definition: a person taking part in a game

entries.definitionCN: 帽子；bowler 是其具体一种
高顶礼帽（口语）；同为帽子俗称

normalIntro.en: One verb, one suffix, two pictures: bowl gives bowler the athlete and bowler the hat.
normalIntro.cn: 一个动词加一个后缀，两幅画面：bowl 既给了投手 bowler，也给了礼帽 bowler。

normal.en: bowl means to roll a ball in games.
-er makes the doer, as in player and runner.
the hat is called bowler after its round bowl-like dome.
normal.cn: 该帽因圆顶如碗（bowl）而得名 bowler。

normal.en: bowling is the alley game with ten pins.
normal.cn: bowling 是十瓶球道的保龄球运动。

normal.en: British English keeps the cricket bowler central.
normal.cn: 英式英语以板球投球手义为核心。

abstract.en: Picture the ball's curve mirrored in the hat's dome.
abstract.cn: 想象球的弧线映在帽子的圆顶上。

abstract.en: One quick delivery decides the over, just as one glance fixes the stereotype.
abstract.cn: 一记快投定乾坤，一如一顶帽子定性一个人。

abstract.en: Roll, release, repeat: the word rolls as smoothly as the ball.
abstract.cn: 滚、出、再滚：这个词像球一样滚得顺滑。

examples.en: The fast bowler rattled the stumps with the very first ball of the innings.
examples.cn: 这位快投手在局首第一球就击中了三柱门。

examples.en: In the city photographs of the period, nearly every clerk wears a bowler.
examples.cn: 那个时期的城市照片里，几乎每个职员都戴着圆顶硬礼帽。

examples.en: Our best bowler rolled three strikes in a row last night.
examples.cn: 我们最棒的保龄球玩家昨晚连投了三个全中。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「抛了」——球「抛了」出去的是投手，头上的硬帽圆得像「抛了」出去的球：bowler 的两副面孔。

root: 中古英语动词 bowl（滚球）+ 施动者后缀 -er；bowl 一般认为源自古法语 boule（球），上溯拉丁语 bulla（气泡、圆物），更早来源不确定。

sensesIntro.en: The doer of the bowling act comes first, then the player of bowling games, and finally the hat whose dome shares the ball's round shape.
sensesIntro.cn: 义项先有投球之人，再有保龄球玩家，最后是圆顶如球的硬礼帽。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a round ball set rolling by a hand, echoed in a round hat
core.cn: 核心意象：一只手把圆球滚出，这圆形又回声般落在圆帽上

branches.en: the cricket arm: the deliverer and the delivery role
branches.cn: 板球一臂：投球者与投球职责

branches.en: the alley arm: the tenpin player
the dome: the hat and its gamekeeper origin
branches.cn: 圆顶：帽子及其猎场看守的来历

branches.en: the uniform of respectability: class written on a hat
branches.cn: 体面的制服：写在帽子上的阶层

branches.en: the rounded hollow and the figurative delivery
branches.cn: 圆凹之物与比喻性的「出手」

intro.en: A transparent agent formation: bowl plus -er, with the hat sense attached by shape rather than by suffix.
intro.cn: 构词透明：bowl 加 -er；帽子义靠形状附着，而非靠后缀。

latinIntro.en: The Latin cognate bulla anchors the family on the continent.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁同源词 bulla 是该词族在欧洲大陆的锚点。
